'''Hele''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who worked as an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], residing on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="location" />
